_note: All user-visible content lives here. Edit freely and restart; logic never depends on the wording. Chapter count, cap and split are the A/B knobs.

lifetimeReward._note: Experiment runs ~2 weeks; a user's total winnings across ALL days stay under totalBudget (90 < the 100 promised). First days follow earlyDaySchedule per user (participation days, not calendar); after that a day pays with laterWinChance, amount drawn from laterGrants. Any payout is at least minGrant; 0-coin days are expected.

coinCredit._note: Fields sent to the internal Coin API (server-side only). {day} in the description is replaced with the product day.

sampleVariants.body: Chandra is steady for you today. Work started before noon will move fast — one old task finally clears.
Surya gives you extra strength this morning. A job you kept pushing away will feel easy if you start it today.
Your mind is calm and sharp today. People will listen when you speak — a good day to say what you have been holding back.
Energy rises after sunrise and stays with you till evening. Finish important work early; the evening is for family.
Chandra favours quiet effort today. Avoid noise and crowds — one hour of focused work will give the result of three.
Today your patience is your power. Something that tested you all week will finally settle without a fight.
A light, lucky day. Small tasks clear fast, and someone senior notices your effort — accept the praise, don't brush it off.
Your body may feel slow but your stars are active. Push through the first hour; the rest of the day rewards you.
Budh is slow this week — avoid new money decisions for now. A talk at home tonight will go your way.
Watch your words after sunset — one sharp sentence can undo a week of goodwill. Stay soft, especially with elders.
Someone may ask you to lend money today. Help with care, but do not empty your own pocket — Shukra warns against it.
An old friend or contact may return with an offer. Listen fully before saying yes — there is one detail they will not mention first.
Do not sign new papers today if you can wait. By tomorrow evening the confusion around them clears on its own.
Small delays in travel or messages are likely before noon. Do not read meaning into silence — the reply comes late, not never.
Guard your health at midday — eat on time and avoid outside food today. A small care now saves a big trouble later.
Someone near you is testing your patience on purpose. Do not give them the reaction they want — your calm is your win today.
Your stars show a delay ending within 15 days. But the exact day — and what to do when it comes — the dice cannot tell.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: When exactly does the delay end, and what should be done on that day?

sampleVariants.body: There is a decision you keep postponing. The stars say the window to act is close — but how close, and which choice is right, needs your full kundli.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: Which choice is right, and when does the window open?

sampleVariants.body: Money is moving toward you from a direction you have stopped watching. Which direction it is — the roll cannot say, only a full reading can.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: From which direction is the money coming?

sampleVariants.body: A person in your circle thinks of you more than they show. The dice see it clearly — but who it is, they will not reveal.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: Who in the circle is thinking of the user?

sampleVariants.body: One door is closing so another can open. The closing you can feel already — the opening has a date, and the dice keep it hidden.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: What is the date and nature of the opening door?

sampleVariants.body: Your name will come up in a conversation you are not part of, and it matters. What is said depends on one thing you do this week — which thing, the roll does not show.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: Which action this week decides how the conversation goes?

sampleVariants.body: The unease you feel is not about what you think it is about. Its real root shows in your birth chart — the dice can only point, not explain.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: What is the real root of the unease in the birth chart?

sampleVariants.body: Something you lost — a chance, a bond, an amount — has a way back. The path exists, but it has a condition the dice cannot read.
sampleVariants.openQuestion: What is the condition for getting back what was lost?
